description: Plain-text observations from a blind vision reviewer. Facts only: no verdicts, no PASS/FLAG language, no praise. Each field describes exactly what is visible in the asset.

anatomy.description: Limbs, hands, feet; any warping, melting, fusion, or extra/missing parts.

cues.description: Program form cues the pose is judged against.

framing.description: Full body in frame, margins, anything important touching edges.

identity.description: Face, hair, wardrobe vs the locked identity spec.

implements.description: Each implement: count, whole or cropped, inside the frame, positioned per the cues.

loop.description: Clips only: last frame vs first frame continuity.

motion.description: Clips only: range of motion vs cues, any teleporting between positions.

pose.description: Body position in plain words, and how it relates to the stated phase and each cue.

scene.description: Gym, equipment present, background, any text/logos.

stability.description: Clips only: equipment morphing, background flicker, wardrobe changes across frames.

style.description: Render style vs the locked look (stylized 3D game character; not photorealistic, not claymation).

title: Exercise visual facts (layer 1 of exercise-form-review)
